title: Edge Detector
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Signal Management/Switches and Counters/Edge_Detector.md
text: Find edges of objects in grayscale pixel stream, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, {Method} sets Edge detection algorithm; {Output the binary image} enables edge output port, {Output the gradient components} enables gradient output ports, {Source of threshold value} sets the source for gradient threshold that indicates an edge, {Threshold value} sets the gradient threshold value that indicates, {Line buffer size} sets the size of the line memory buffer, {Padding method} sets the method for padding, {Rounding mode} sets the rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow action for internal fixed-point and {Gradient Data Type} sets the data type for gradient output ports Inherit via internal. Values come from the instance.
